interactions.label: THE GATE
interactions.dialog: A SHRINE GATE STANDING IN THE BLACK WATER UP TO ITS KNEES, RED PAINT STILL ON IT. WHEN THE CITY WAS BUILT ON TOP OF THIS STREET, NOBODY MOVED IT. NOBODY DARED.

interactions.label: BILLBOARD
interactions.dialog: A BILLBOARD FALLEN FROM SOMEWHERE FAR ABOVE: HALCYON - LIVE HIGHER. HALF ITS PIXELS STILL WORK. THE DRONES HAVE NESTED IN THE FRAME.

interactions.label: TIDE LINE
interactions.dialog: THE OLD STREET'S SHOPFRONTS, A GREEN LINE WAIST HIGH ACROSS EVERY DOOR WHERE THE WATER STOOD FOR YEARS. A SIGN STILL READS: "OPEN 24 HOURS".

interactions.label: SLEEPER
interactions.dialog: SOMEONE LIVES HERE, AT THE BOTTOM OF EVERYTHING: A MATTRESS, A RADIO, A CAN OF SOUP WARMING ON A CANDLE. THEY ARE NOT HOME.
